title: The Architecture of Trust: A Framework for AI-Augmented Real Estate Valuation in the Era of Structured Data

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed evaluation using LLM judges to screen generated real estate reports for discriminatory language, euphemisms masking discrimination, and Fair Housing Act compliance, alongside applying fairness metrics like demographic parity and equalized odds across historically redlined neighborhoods.

Analyzed through the statistical observation of 'appraisal inflation' or 'contract price confirmation bias,' where property valuations disproportionately land at or slightly above the agreed contract price.

Evaluated through human-AI collaboration metrics, specifically analyzing appraiser override rates, temporal override patterns, and the calibration between AI-expressed uncertainty and human acceptance to detect over-reliance on algorithmic recommendations.
